{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/sh
# Flux batch script converted from PBS

# NOTE: Run with: flux batch <this_script>

# PBS resources:
#   -N hddm-paper
#   -l nodes=20:ppn=8   (160 MPI ranks total)
#   -l walltime=10:00:00
#   -r n

#flux: --job-name=hddm-paper
#flux: -N 20
#flux: -n 160
#flux: -c 1
#flux: --time-limit=10h

# Omitted PBS option: -r n (non-rerunnable)
# Flux does not have a universal portable directive for PBS rerunnable semantics.
# Performance implication: none for performance, but job restart behavior/policies may differ.

# PBS used $PBS_NODEFILE; under Flux this variable is not available.
# Performance implication: none directly, but launch commands that rely on $PBS_NODEFILE must be adapted.

. hddm_venv2/bin/activate

cd HDDM-paper

echo "Launching controller"
ipcontroller --profile=mpi &
sleep 10

echo "Launching engines"
# PBS used mpirun with machinefile; under Flux, use flux-run to start 160 ranks.
# Export requested environment variables similarly to `-x`.
flux run -n 160 -c 1 \
  --env=PATH \
  --env=PYTHON_PATH \
  --env=VIRTUAL_ENV \
  --cwd=$HOME/HDDM-paper \
  ipengine --profile=mpi &
sleep 10

echo "Launching job"
python $HOME/HDDM-paper/run_estimation.py -r -a --profile mpi --parallel --all -st -sz -z
"
}
